modalities.evidence: Block-design task-fMRI of expert kundalini-yoga chakra meditation

output.population: Two expert kundalini-yoga practitioners (N = 2 practitioners), sub-01 across three sessions and sub-02 in one session
output.summary: Small-N proof-of-concept task-fMRI dataset of expert kundalini-yoga chakra meditation, with block-design runs pairing yogic resting-state baselines and chakra meditation blocks, acquired across pilot sessions with differing echo and fieldmap setups.
